Such backdoor accounts are more dangerous in industrial IoT devices than in consumer devices, because industrial devices are often directly exposed to the internet and handle critical production tasks. Notably, the author did not publish the full password, only described the discovery process. This reflects the responsible disclosure principle in security research—giving vendors time to fix the issue without handing ready-made tools to malicious attackers. From a broader perspective, the second-hand device market is a neglected attack surface. Users who buy used industrial equipment for security audits may unknowingly encounter devices with hidden backdoors. For security researchers conducting penetration tests, this is both an opportunity and a legal risk.
